text: Dear all, I recently came to Israel after a long partner visa process (10 months I was not allowed to enter Israel) and now I am on a 6 months visa without work permission. Also, upon receiving this visa I was told that I can't leave the country for the time being until we have our interview in February. This was not communicated before and I have commitments abroad in November. Now, the PIBA staff told me that I can only leave on proof that travel is essential. Has anyone here done this and has some tips on how to make this successful and easy? Any answers are much appreciated 🙏
